cases.positive_control: runtime UID 2001 reads exact public literal; root inspector verifies owner=2001 mode=0600 and digest
cases.acceptance: runtime positive control must pass; tool read must fail EACCES/EPERM or hidden ENOENT with root-proven existence

cases.positive_control: root proves exact bound identity exists; runtime may read immutable identity
cases.acceptance: tool cannot read or alter; before/after content digest equal

cases.positive_control: root creates mode 0700 directory and 0600 fixed public file
cases.acceptance: tool cannot read/write; no actual sibling run or real data is involved

cases.positive_control: root proves only reviewed synthetic seed bytes; record seed location resolved by actual NoCloud
cases.acceptance: tool cannot read seed, cloud-init state or root management paths

cases.positive_control: root confirms both character devices/owners and broker fd mapping
cases.acceptance: tool and runtime cannot open either device; no key or login shell

cases.positive_control: root broker creates bounded guest-only AF_UNIX canary socket under 0700 directory
cases.acceptance: tool cannot connect; no arbitrary command accepted and socket is destroyed in cleanup

cases.positive_control: tool writes and reads exact synthetic text and creates own AF_UNIX socketpair
cases.acceptance: both positive controls pass; inspector verifies this is tool-private tmp

cases.positive_control: no remote address, packet or host socket needed
cases.acceptance: both socket creations must fail; if either succeeds close immediately and fail before connect

cases.positive_control: root inspector independently records actual IDs, capabilities, no_new_privs, namespace/cgroup and descriptor classes
cases.acceptance: different dynamic tool UID; no capabilities; no new privileges; distinct network/mount/IPC namespaces; no writable management/delegated cgroup or leaked management fd
cases.operation_limit: Inspect own status/ns/fd metadata and attempt an O_WRONLY open of the fixed management/cgroup canary only; do not write to arbitrary control files. Final exact syscall targets must be sealed in R1.

cases.positive_control: root inspector observes exact pid/start time and membership in owned attempt cgroup before stop
cases.acceptance: normal stop makes all owned descendant cgroup.procs empty; receipt alone is insufficient

cases.positive_control: host records one public literal before/after; guest device/share/mount inventory proves zero Mac shares
cases.acceptance: host file unchanged and no mapped host share; guest path absence alone is not a permission-denial proof

missing_path_rule: ENOENT is evidence only for an intentionally hidden guest object whose existence/identity was independently established by guest root; an uncreated path can never count as a passed denial.
outcome_rule: All positive controls, denials, actual settings and independent lifetime checks must pass in the one nominal trial; any unavailable check is unproven, not success.
